$comment: Capabilities the ESP build packs check (adapters/destinations/build/capabilities.py). Trimmed from the 2026-10-21 research (every fact keeps its source URL and confidence: VERIFIED read on the vendor's own documentation or official OpenAPI spec, LIKELY from a secondary source or an inference, UNVERIFIED could not be confirmed). Checks: kind requirement fails the pack when hard and unmet; an unknown tier or option is a warning, never a pass. Edit facts here, not in code.

confidence_legend.VERIFIED: read on the vendor's own documentation, help center, developer reference, official OpenAPI spec or official training
confidence_legend.LIKELY: secondary source, or a reasonable inference from partial official text
confidence_legend.UNVERIFIED: could not be confirmed; nothing that depends on it is created without --allow-unverified

account_shape.tier: the platform's plan tier (HubSpot: free, starter, professional, enterprise)

options.canvas_context: Braze: true when Canvas Context is available in the workspace
options.events_in_esp: list of engine event names that reach the platform
options.event_names: map of engine event name to the platform's name for it
options.shopify: Klaviyo: true when the Shopify integration sends Started Checkout, Viewed Product and Placed Order
options.ids: map of placeholder to id (metric, template, email, list, event type)
options.eu: Customer.io or Iterable EU data center

tiers.note: no plan gate was found for metric, list or segment flow triggers; the tier is not used by any check

min_delay.note: TimeDelayActionData.unit enum is days, hours, minutes in the official OpenAPI spec (revision 2026-10-15); the help center lists the same units

trigger_types.note: FlowDefinition.triggers oneOf in the OpenAPI spec; exactly one trigger per flow

segment_entry_trigger.note: segment-triggered flows fire when a profile newly qualifies; segment triggers default to no re-entry

reentry.note: ReentryCriteria: with unit 'alltime', duration 1 means no re-entry and 0 allows re-entry; help center options: Enter only once, Re-enter whenever they re-qualify, Re-enter after a minimum time period (https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/360003040052)

create_api.note: flows are created in Draft unless an action status says otherwise; there is no documented way to update a definition after creation (https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/flows_api_overview)

template_create_api.note: drag-and-drop templates are limited to 2 per app partner (https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/flows_api_overview); the engine creates CODE (HTML) templates

metric_lookup.note: metrics cannot be filtered by name, so ids are found by paging the list and matching attributes.name

frequency.note: Smart Sending skips a marketing message when the profile got one on that channel inside the window; it is a time window, not a count

send_window.note: there is no generic hour-range window on a minutes or hours delay; SMS messages carry sms_quiet_hours_enabled (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable.json)

shopify_metric_names.note: Shopify's data reference lists Checkout Started; flows commonly show Started Checkout: confirm the name in the account

built_in_metric_names.note: Klaviyo's built-in email metrics; names not re-read on an official page this session

in_app.note: no in-app message action among the flow action types

value.retry: 429 and 503 with exponential backoff and jitter, honoring Retry-After

checks.requirement: Custom behavioral event enrollment needs Professional or Enterprise (Marketing, Sales, Service, Data, Content, Smart CRM or Revenue Hub); since March 2026 it is no longer Enterprise only
The Send email workflow action needs Marketing Hub (or Service Hub) Professional or Enterprise
The email frequency safeguard (a send cap across emails) is Marketing Hub Enterprise; on lower tiers the plan's cap holds only inside this workflow
Workflow time windows ('Run actions at specific times only') need Professional or Enterprise, and use the account time zone, not the recipient's
The automation v4 flows API is beta and subject to change: the artifact pins POST /automation/v4/flows and is created with isEnabled false
Workflow emails cannot loop over event data (256 characters per value, 50 properties): write lcm_last_item_name and lcm_last_item_url to the contact when the event is sent
SMS, push and in-app steps are not in the verified workflow action list: the artifact sends the email version at those steps; add an SMS action by hand where your account has one
Create Flow and Create Segment are limited to 1 per second, 15 per minute and 100 per day
A flow definition cannot be changed through the API after it is created (only its status): review the artifact before --create, then edit in the flow builder
Smart Sending is a per-channel time window (email 16 hours by default), not a count: the plan's weekly cap is approximated by Smart Sending plus the flow's own spacing
Klaviyo has no hour-range window on a minutes or hours delay: hour-level touches send when the delay ends (SMS still follows Klaviyo's SMS quiet hours setting)
Klaviyo flows have no in-app message action: in-app steps are left out of the artifact; deliver them from your product
The product block reads {{context.${items}}}: Canvas Context must be available in the workspace (availability varies by workspace)
No Braze endpoint creates or updates a Canvas: the pack is a build sheet (optionally a /canvas/duplicate request from a template Canvas you made)
The /canvas/duplicate body, resulting status and limits are not documented on the page read: the request is UNVERIFIED and is sent only with --allow-unverified
Braze has no 'enters segment' entry: the native mode is a daily Scheduled Canvas on a segment that holds people only on the day they cross the line
Quiet hours are set on the Canvas, not per step (user local time; Send at next available time)
Global frequency caps count by calendar day in the user's time zone, and a capped user advances past a Message step without the send
/users/track has no idempotency key: lcm send keeps a client-side sent log so a rerun never pushes an entrant twice
The App API cannot create campaigns (only update an existing action): the pack is a build sheet
Message limits apply only to workflows that opt in: turn the limit on in this campaign's settings, or the plan's cap is not enforced across campaigns
A Time Delay in minutes is LIKELY but not stated on the pages read: confirm a sub-hour delay saves, or round it to the hour
The templates use the default filter, which legacy Liquid lacks: the workspace must be on latest Liquid (accounts from 28 Nov 2023 are)
Only events timestamped in the last 72 hours trigger a campaign: push the day's entrants the same day
No create or update journey endpoint was found (only list and trigger): the pack is a build sheet
Frequency Management is off by default: set the cap in project settings; capped messages are skipped and the user moves on
Quiet Hours are set on each send tile (Delivery and Compliance), from the user's timeZone field
Event fields (items) reach the template only when the journey is triggered by that event; that they reach every send tile is LIKELY
Re-sending an event with the same id updates it; whether that update re-triggers a journey is unknown, so lcm send never re-sends an accepted row
The journey is created in Draft; publishing is a separate call (publishAsync) the pack never makes
The Decision Split's type string and Filter XML criteria are UNVERIFIED (the format page could not be read): the journey is created only with --allow-unverified; check the split in Journey Builder
No hard Journey Builder frequency cap was found: the plan's cap holds only inside this journey
Trailhead advises avoiding waits under an hour
API Event entry has no idempotency key: a row whose push succeeded and whose ledger mark failed enters twice
SMS and push activity formats were not verified: the artifact sends the email version at those steps; add MobileConnect or MobilePush activities by hand

Every event the flow reads inside the platform (the trigger, the exit, the exclusions) must reach the platform: account option events_in_esp lists them. A native absence trigger whose events are not in the platform needs --warehouse-job
Every wait must be a whole number of the platform's smallest delay unit
The rendered copy must be in this platform's template dialect
